 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. A dramatic 4-4 draw against Aston Villa pushed Manchester United into the relegation zone heading into the November international break.
 With just one win in 10 Premier League games, the Red Devils have made their worst start to a domestic campaign in 40 years.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Carrick and the players were given Monday off after their clash against Villa, and the head coach and his staff are due back at Carrington on Tuesday. However, late developments on Monday night may mean they have already overseen their final training session at the club.
 "Major twist" could see Mauricio Pochettino replace Michael Carrick
 According the The Athletic , Manchester United are expected to relieve Michael Carrick of his duties as head coach.
 "Club insiders insisted on Monday night that no final decision has been made," the report states. "However, chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox are expected to recommend a change in the dugout."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Amid this, USA national team manager Mauricio Pochettino is reportedly emerging as a potential option to replace him.
 It is claimed that the former Tottenham Hotspur and Chelsea boss Pochettino has always been keen on the United post and has a release clause in his contract, which is due to run until 2030.
